rule.name: One invoice per payroll & staffing supplier per month
rule.condition: Each payroll, recruiter and employer-of-record payee should be paid once per calendar month
rule.breach_condition: A second invoice from the same payee in the same month

rationale: Nothing in the policy limited how often a supplier can bill, so a second in-range Fathom invoice looked routine. History shows Fathom, Remote People and Deel billing once per calendar month. Backtest flags 6 past payments: in September, Isla Fraser, Priya Chandra and Rhys Owen were each paid twice (18th and 25th), £11,800 in one month. Seapoint's payroll shows why: the October run was paid early, on 18 Sep. Those are real findings, not false alarms.
